saturation.note: Pass 1 harvested surface repetitions (task bullets, For Task N, numbered strength blocks). Pass 2 harvested syntactic frames (Despite + adjective + noun, With + nominalisation, In contrast + cluster). Pass 3 over the same 12 chapters produced no new reusable move; the last three candidates were variants of frames already recorded at 004, 013 and 014.

g3_mining.method: Three-level harvest on the cleaned page text. Level 1: repeated strings and glyph-led openings. Level 2: recurring syntactic frames with slot positions. Level 3: shared information order across different content, which is how 011 and 014 were separated from their neighbours.
g3_mining.support_measure: Cross-paper support counts papers in the 435-paper corpus whose text contains every fixed fragment of the abstraction (at least two words per fragment). Occurrence counts are reported for the longest fragment only.
g3_mining.boundary_rule: A frame is recorded only if it can be stated with slots that carry different content in a different domain; frames that need the paper's own subject matter to sound natural are recorded as recorded_absences instead.
